scenes.heading: Growing an email list that actually converts

sents.d: Growing an email list that actually converts
A relevant lead magnet beats a generic discount code.

A lead magnet works best when it solves one specific, narrow problem your ideal customer has right now — a generic 'sign up for updates' offer converts far worse than something like a specific checklist or short guide.
Once someone joins your list, a short welcome sequence (3–5 emails) introducing who you are and what you offer performs better than immediately pitching a sale.
Segment your list over time based on what people click or buy, so later emails can be more relevant instead of one generic blast to everyone.

take: Offer a specific lead magnet, then welcome before you sell.
